mode.title: Mode
mode.description: "article" extracts one or more article URLs (Russian or English edition). "latest" fetches the newest headlines from the RSS feed.

url.title: Article URL
url.description: A single meduza.io article URL to extract -- works for both the Russian edition (meduza.io/...) and the English edition (meduza.io/en/...). Used when mode is "article".

urls.title: Article URLs
urls.description: Multiple meduza.io article URLs to extract in one run. Used when mode is "article".

limit.title: Max headlines (latest mode)
limit.description: Maximum number of headlines to return in "latest" mode.

language.title: Edition (latest mode)
language.description: Which edition's RSS feed to read in "latest" mode -- English (curated, partly AI-translated) or Russian (the original, full-volume feed).

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many article pages to fetch in parallel in "article" mode.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default.
